prompt: Create an ultra-realistic, high-end minimalist streetwear fashion portrait of a confident young adult Black man standing full-body in a warm beige photography studio. He faces the camera directly with a calm, serious editorial expression, short neat black hair, clean-shaven face, relaxed posture, one hand in his pants pocket and the other resting naturally at his side. Dress him in an oversized brown-and-cream athletic streetwear jersey with a wide cream horizontal chest band, bold collegiate lettering reading STREWEAR, the number 33 on the chest, and matching numbers on both sleeves; pair it with loose black track pants with white drawstrings and thin white side stripes, plus clean white low-top sneakers. The studio should have a seamless warm tan wall and floor, tall sheer cream curtains on both left and right edges, and one potted palm plant in a terracotta pot at the lower left. Use golden-hour sunlight streaming from the side to cast long diagonal window shadows across the wall and floor, creating a soft luxury editorial mood without any visible brand logos. Compose as a vertical full-body fashion photo, centered subject, eye-level camera, natural proportions, sharp facial detail, realistic fabric texture, soft shadows, warm color grading, clean youthful masculine style, no extra people, no accessories, no watermark.
